notes: No amp+cab block — running into tube amp. Three snapshots: verse/clean, heavy riff, bridge/breakdown. Confirmed rig: Diezel VH4 (Das Benzin Lead — removed per amp+cab policy). Scream 808 (TS808) confirmed as clean boost into amp for heavy sections. Pitch Wham (DigiTech Whammy) confirmed for octave-down harmony — Bellamy uses Whammy set to Harmony -1 octave, blending dry with octave-down signal. Poly Wham (Helix version) auto-assigns to EXP 1. EQ compensates for removed Das Benzin Lead and 4x12 V30 cab voicing — aggressive mid boost at 700Hz is the defining characteristic of Bellamy's Resistance-era tone. IMPORTANT: Dynamic Hall Room Size must NOT be snapshot-variable — set as fixed value to avoid audible algorithm bump.

signal_chain.notes: Transparent clean boost tightening tube amp low end and adding small amount of gain. Minimal Gain, neutral Tone, high Level. BYPASSED in Snapshot 1 (clean verse). ACTIVE in Snapshots 2 and 3.

Confirmed: Bellamy uses DigiTech Whammy set to Harmony -1 octave for MK Ultra riff — blends dry signal with octave-down voice. Heel Pitch 0 (unison) + Toe Pitch -12 (one octave down). Position 100 = full toe-down = full octave-down blend at set Mix level. ACTIVE in all snapshots but Mix varies significantly — S1 subtle shimmer (15%), S2 prominent octave-down (40%), S3 most prominent (50%).

Compensates for removed Das Benzin Lead and 4x12 Brit V30 cab voicing. Heavy snapshots use aggressive mid boost at 700Hz — defining characteristic of Bellamy's Resistance-era tone. Drop D requires firm Low Cut to prevent open string flabbiness. S2 most aggressive — maximum mid boost, tightest cuts.

Cosmos Echo chosen for Muse presets — Bass and Treble tone controls allow darker repeats in heavy snapshots. Tempo-synced to 128 BPM. S1: d1/8 (352ms, 28ms off original 380ms target — synced preferred). S2: d1/16 (176ms, 12ms off original 188ms — synced). S3: d1/8 (352ms, near exact match to original 350ms). S2 very short and dark — minimal delay so Pitch Wham octave voice stays defined.

Room Size FIXED at 20m — do NOT make snapshot-variable, causes audible algorithm bump. S1 long and cinematic. S2 very tight and punchy — riff must not be washy. S3 medium — bridge more expansive than heavy riff.

expression_pedal.note: Pitch Wham auto-assigns to EXP 1. For live performance in Snapshot 1, sweep from heel (Position 0, unison) toward toe (Position 100, full octave down) as verse builds intensity. Snapshots 2+3 use fixed Position 100.

1_verse.description: Verse/clean. Scream 808 bypassed. Pitch Wham Position 50 — midpoint between unison and octave down, Mix 15% (barely audible sub-octave shimmer). Long reverb (3.2 sec, 42% mix). Dotted eighth delay at 38% mix. EXP pedal can sweep Pitch Wham from heel to toe as verse builds.

2_heavy_riff.description: Heavy riff. Scream 808 active (clean boost into tube amp). Pitch Wham Position 100, Mix 40% — prominent octave-down voice replicating Whammy Harmony -1 octave. Most aggressive EQ: Low Gain -4dB, Mid +5dB at 700Hz, High Gain -3dB. Very short d1/16 delay (176ms, 15% mix). Tight reverb (0.8 sec, 15% mix).

3_bridge.description: Bridge/breakdown. Scream 808 bypassed. Pitch Wham Position 100, Mix 50% — most prominent octave-down voice of the three snapshots. Moderate EQ. Dotted eighth delay at 40% mix. Medium reverb (2.0 sec, 30% mix).

playing_notes.tuning: Drop D throughout — tune low E string down to D
playing_notes.pickup_notes: Neck for Snapshot 1. Bridge for Snapshots 2+3.
playing_notes.technique: Pitch Wham tracks single notes best — play riff with clean separated notes and firm pick attack. Avoid overlapping notes in Snapshot 2 or octave tracking will glitch.
playing_notes.snapshot_cues: Snapshot 1: verse. Use EXP pedal to sweep Pitch Wham Position from heel to toe as verse builds, then switch to Snapshot 2 as heavy riff begins. Snapshot 3: bridge/breakdown sections.
playing_notes.guitar_tone_control: Roll guitar tone knob back to around 7 for Snapshots 2+3 — helps Pitch Wham octave tracking accuracy and prevents harshness through high-gain tube amp
